title: malache sulphurea
intro: Malache sulphurea, commonly known as Yellow Gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. Therapeutically, Malache sulphurea is used as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, helping to relieve symptoms associated with colds, coughs, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Malache sulphurea include gentianine, amarogentin, and secoiridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
